Staff scan a crate label to see its inventory identity and record a receipt or return; a damaged label can be replaced. The cooperative wants readable printed identifiers even when a scanner is offline. Its legacy sheet records crate identity separately from each shipment. This research is about identifiers and scanning workflows, not payment or food-safety decisions.

Do not let these leads prevent discovery of a better fit or an analogous mechanism.
